notes: Statutory rates are data, not law: they are the pack's stated version and every deployment confirms them with its accountant before use.
Movable observances (Chinese New Year, Eid'l Fitr, Eid'l Adha) are proclaimed year by year and are added by proclamation, not guessed here.
The fiscal year start is deliberately null: plan §8 leaves it undecided, so it must be confirmed with the pack before a company in this market is created.
